name: b2_shop_app
request: I run a small shop and want an app to keep track of my customers and my stock. I should have to log in first - my username is owner and my password is sunrise42. After logging in I want a dashboard that shows how many customers I have, how many products I have, and how many products are low on stock (fewer than 5 left). I need a Customers page where I can add a customer (name, phone and email) and search customers by name. I need a Products page where I can add a product (name, price and quantity) and search products by name. Everything must be saved in a database so nothing is lost if the app restarts, and it must work well on a phone.
